'MAG-IINGAY SA EDSA': YOUTH, PROGRESSIVE GROUPS STAGE NOISE BARRAGE FOR ACCOUNTABILITY

Progressive groups staged a "White Friday Noise Barrage" at the historic People Power Monument to demand accountability in the multibillion-peso flood control scandal.

Led by Akbayan Partylist, Akbayan Youth, Youth Against Kurakot (YAK!), the Student Council Alliance of the Philippines (SCAP), and Tindig Pilipinas, the protest built on the momentum of the recent Trillion Peso March and amplified calls for transparency and punishment of corrupt politicians and contractors.

Akbayan Youth Secretary General and YAK! convenor Khylla Meneses said public outrage remains unresolved, describing the resignation of Ako Bicol Party-list Rep. Zaldy Co and Vice President Sara Duterte's budget request as a political spectacle aimed at dodging scrutiny.

SCAP Secretary General Matthew Silverio noted the growing unrest in schools and universities, pointing to student actions that reflect mounting frustration with corruption.

The groups pledged to sustain their campaign for transparency and reforms until full accountability is achieved.

📷 Akbayan Partylist

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4-Corrected #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: TROPICAL CYCLONE "PAOLO"
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Tarlac(Camiling, San Clemente, Mayantoc, Santa Ignacia, San Jose, Capas, Bamban) and Pampanga(Lubao, Porac, Angeles, Mabalacat, Floridablanca).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija, Cavite, Tarlac(Concepcion, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Pura, Victoria, San Manuel, Moncada, Anao, Paniqui, Ramos), Pampanga(Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Guagua, Santa Rita), Bulacan(Calumpit, Malolos, Paombong, Hagonoy, Bulakan, Obando, Meycauayan, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto) and Batangas(Balayan, Calaca, Calatagan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Nasugbu, Tuy, Bauan, Mabini, San Luis, Santa Teresita, Taal, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Tingloy, Talisay).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Batangas(Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Pascual, Santo Tomas, Taysan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, Pandi, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria), Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) and Laguna(Pangil, Pakil, Siniloan, Famy, Santa Maria, Mabitac, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Calamba, Cabuyao) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
